title: REQ · Clicking an object opens its action menu
summary: Hotspot click opens the ActionMenu with the object description and actions, identifiable by object id
description: Context: App holds selectedId and renders ActionMenu for the selected SceneObjectView. Desired behavior: the menu section carries the object id so the flow is assertable without relying on text. Expected result: clicking Bookshelf shows its menu with Inspect, Push, Search, Leave. Why: the entry point to all interactions.
acceptance_criteria: Given the playing view, when Bookshelf is clicked, then a region named Bookshelf contains Inspect, Push, Search and Leave buttons
Given no hotspot is selected, when the view renders, then no action menu region exists
